definitions.explanation: The rear portion of the head, behind and below the crown. Used in medical, descriptive, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {後頭部|こうとうぶ}を{打|う}った。
examples.english: I hit the back of my head.

examples.japanese: {後頭部|こうとうぶ}に{痛|いた}みを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I feel pain in the back of my head.

examples.japanese: {転|ころ}んで{後頭部|こうとうぶ}を{強|つよ}く{打|う}ったので、{病院|びょういん}で{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I hit the back of my head hard when I fell, so I got checked at the hospital.

notes:
A compound of {後頭|こうとう} (occiput, back of the head) and {部|ぶ} (part, region). A standard anatomical term that is also used frequently in everyday language, especially when describing injuries, haircuts, or head-related issues.

USAGE:
Commonly appears in medical descriptions, accident reports, and everyday conversation about bumping or injuring one's head. Also used by hairstylists to describe the back area of a haircut.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後頭部|こうとうぶ}を{打|う}つ — to hit the back of one's head
- {後頭部|こうとうぶ}が{痛|いた}い — the back of the head hurts
- {後頭部|こうとうぶ}を{触|さわ}る — to touch the back of one's head

RELATED WORDS:
- {前頭部|ぜんとうぶ} — forehead area; the front of the head
- {側頭部|そくとうぶ} — temple area; the side of the head
- {頭頂部|とうちょうぶ} — crown of the head; the top
